panels.description: Sum of Reps x Weight_kg across all sets in range (Weight_kg>0 only; excludes cardio warmups).

targets.query: SELECT SUM(vol) AS total_volume FROM (SELECT Reps*Weight_kg AS vol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter)

panels.title: Total Volume

panels.description: Count of sets with Weight_kg > 0 in range. This excludes bodyweight/cardio-only entries (e.g. unweighted pull-ups, ROW/INDOOR_ROW warmups) that are logged inside strength activities but carry no load — so this number is lower than the raw row count for the same range. See 'Sets Needing Classification' below for data-quality flags.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(Reps) AS total_sets FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Weighted Sets

panels.description: Sum of reps across weighted sets in range.

targets.query: SELECT SUM(Reps) AS total_reps FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Total Reps

panels.description: Distinct days with at least one weighted set (one row per training day).

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(dvol) AS workouts FROM (SELECT SUM(vol) AS dvol FROM (SELECT Reps*Weight_kg AS vol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none))

panels.title: Number of Workouts

panels.description: Mean per-workout training volume in range.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN(dvol) AS avg_volume FROM (SELECT SUM(vol) AS dvol FROM (SELECT Reps*Weight_kg AS vol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none))

panels.title: Avg Volume / Workout

panels.description: Best estimated 1-rep max per exercise per workout day, using the Epley formula Weight_kg * (1 + Reps/30). Filter by $ExerciseCategory / $ExerciseLabel above. This is the single most useful panel for tracking progressive overload.

targets.query: SELECT MAX(epley) AS e1rm FROM (SELECT Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND ExerciseCategory =~ /^$ExerciseCategory$/ AND ExerciseLabel =~ /^$ExerciseLabel$/ AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY time(1d), ExerciseLabel fill(none)

panels.title: Estimated 1RM Progression (Epley) by Exercise

panels.description: Total volume (kg) per workout day (Reps x Weight_kg, summed across all weighted sets that day).

targets.query: SELECT SUM(vol) AS Volume FROM (SELECT Reps*Weight_kg AS vol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none)

panels.title: Training Volume per Workout

panels.description: Heaviest single set and best estimated 1RM (Epley) per exercise in the selected range.

targets.query: SELECT MAX(Weight_kg) AS "Max Weight (kg)", MAX(epley) AS "Best Est. 1RM (kg)" FROM (SELECT Weight_kg, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND ExerciseCategory =~ /^$ExerciseCategory$/ AND ExerciseLabel =~ /^$ExerciseLabel$/ AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY ExerciseLabel

panels.title: Personal Records (Top Set & Est. 1RM)

panels.description: Training volume (kg) split by exercise category — shows muscle-group balance.

targets.query: SELECT SUM(vol) AS Volume FROM (SELECT Reps*Weight_kg AS vol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND ExerciseCategory =~ /^$ExerciseCategory$/ AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY ExerciseCategory

panels.title: Volume by Category

panels.description: Number of weighted sets per exercise category — complements the volume pie (a category can have many sets but low volume, or vice versa).

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(Reps) AS Sets FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND ExerciseCategory =~ /^$ExerciseCategory$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY ExerciseCategory

panels.title: Sets by Category

panels.description: Most recent individual sets: exercise, reps, weight, and volume.

targets.query: SELECT ExerciseLabel AS "Exercise", Reps, Weight_kg AS "Weight (kg)", Reps*Weight_kg AS "Volume (kg)", SetOrder AS "Set #" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND ExerciseCategory =~ /^$ExerciseCategory$/ AND ExerciseLabel =~ /^$ExerciseLabel$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent Sets (Workout Detail)

panels.description: One row per workout day: total sets, reps, volume, and cumulative active set duration. Not filtered by exercise picker (whole-session view).

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(Reps) AS "Sets", SUM(Reps) AS "Reps", SUM(vol) AS "Volume (kg)", SUM(dur) AS "Time Under Tension (s)" FROM (SELECT Reps, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Duration_s AS dur FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none)

panels.title: Workout Summary (per session)

panels.description: Time spent in each heart-rate zone during strength sessions, from StrengthHRZones. ZoneNumber/ZoneLowBoundary are per-activity fields (not tags), so each zone is queried as a separate target filtered by ZoneNumber.

targets.query: SELECT SUM(SecsInZone) AS secs FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE ZoneNumber=1 AND $timeFilter
SELECT SUM(SecsInZone) AS secs FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE ZoneNumber=2 AND $timeFilter
SELECT SUM(SecsInZone) AS secs FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE ZoneNumber=3 AND $timeFilter
SELECT SUM(SecsInZone) AS secs FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE ZoneNumber=4 AND $timeFilter
SELECT SUM(SecsInZone) AS secs FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE ZoneNumber=5 AND $timeFilter

panels.title: HR Zone Time Distribution (Strength Sessions)

panels.description: Total accumulated active-set duration (sum of Duration_s) per exercise in the selected range.

targets.query: SELECT SUM(Duration_s) AS "Total Time Under Tension (s)" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND ExerciseCategory =~ /^$ExerciseCategory$/ AND ExerciseLabel =~ /^$ExerciseLabel$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY ExerciseLabel

panels.title: Time Under Tension by Exercise

panels.description: Count of training days bucketed into weekly bins. fill(0) is intentional here: a week with no workout genuinely has zero, not missing data.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(dvol) AS Workouts FROM (SELECT SUM(vol) AS dvol FROM (SELECT Reps*Weight_kg AS vol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none)) GROUP BY time(1w) fill(0)

panels.title: Workouts per Week

panels.description: One cell per calendar day: green = at least one weighted set logged that day, gray = rest day.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(Reps) AS sets FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(0)

panels.title: Workout Calendar

panels.description: Sets Garmin could not classify into an exercise (ExerciseCategory=UNKNOWN). Not dropped from other panels, but flagged here — fix labels in Garmin Connect to improve categorization.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(Reps) AS unknown_sets FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE ExerciseCategory='UNKNOWN' AND $timeFilter
